summary: Built auto-extract-decisions: proposes durable-decision note nodes {title,summary,knowledge[]} from a conversation turn WITHOUT an explicit record_decision() call, routed through the SAME reviewable candidate-bundle/accept-gate as ingest-v1's inject.js (dry-run default, --confirm injects as [auto]-prefixed notes via POST /overlay/note, idempotent via /state title-skip). Isolates solo assistant turns from a .jsonl transcript (or --turns for eval); precision-biased heuristic decision/finding/constraint scorer; dedups each candidate against live KB via GET /search (search_knowledge), fail-open if daemon down. Files: scripts/extract-decisions.js + test/extract-decisions.test.js on branch orch/attempt/auto-extract-decisions (commit 8f3a80e). Tested: node --check clean; precision 1.0 / recall 1.0 on a 10-turn labeled sample; live dry-run on a real transcript (0 candidates, correct — no decision prose) and on sample turns (3 kept, chatter dropped, real KB dedup ran); dedup-drop path verified (matched [ingest] overlay note score 0.629 -> dropped); extract+search-knowledge tests pass. Smoke 72/11 is a pre-existing daemon-teardown Killed:9, identical with my files removed. HELD FOR MERGE: committed on isolated branch only, main untouched, no graph injected (never ran --confirm). Pre-existing uncommitted hooks/orch-gate.sh change left untouched.
